author: LinkOFeare
body:
The Prime Platoon is a competitive and brand new team looking for the most skilled of the skilled, the most qualified of the qualified, and the best of the best players on the Avicus Network. Our team focuses on reaching for the goal and never giving up. Our motto is "Win or lose, it's up to you.".


Commander-In-Chief: LinkOFeare
Don't worry about my stats, I'll be commanding and defending throughout most games.
--------------------------------------------
POSITIONS:

The Defenders - (defend throughout the majority, if not the entire, of the game)
- Should wear full iron armor
- Should know many defense tactics
- Should be decent at PvP
- Should be decent at archery

The Destroyers - (go for the obsidian, complete offense)
- Should be excellent at PvP
- Somewhat good at archery
- Able to use controls quickly
- Should know many strategies and tactics

The Engineers - (TNT Maps ~ create cannons, build [sky] bridges)
- Only access to TNT (if available)
- Does not need full armor
- Should be quick, meticulous, and efficient
- Ability to decently shoot arrows
- Manual work (Creating the armor)

The Mid-line Maniacs - (Stay around mid-line/end of team territory)
- Be great at archery
- Decent at PvP
- Observant
- Informs others of incoming attacks

-------------------------------------------------------------
RULES:
1. Be respectful towards the opposing team.
2. Follow what the Commander-In-Chief commands.
3. Be as active as possible.
4. Don't suck at the game.
5. Show good, appropriate team spirit.
6. Have as much fun as you can.

--------------------------------------------------------------
THE APPLICATION FORMAT (copy/paste):
  • IGN:
  • K/D Ratio:
  • Kills (round to nearest 100):
  • Deaths (round to nearest 100):
  • Primary Positon:
  • Second-best Position:
  • Skype (optional):
  • Favorite Color:
  • Previous Teams (if any):
  • Active (yes or no):
  • Do you want to be on this team?
      The information displayed above is completely accurate and I want to be a part of the Prime Platoon. 
                 - ____(IGN)____
